purpose: Translate internal investigation state into a simple citizen-facing timeline showing progress, required action and publication state without exposing internal or restricted information.
visibility_rules: Show the citizen only the stage, relevant action and material reason.
Do not expose internal engine names, dependency graph details, hidden confidence scores or internal chain-of-thought.
Do not expose restricted personal information or unrelated source contents.
A waiting state should explain what is needed without revealing unnecessary internal data.
A limitation should be communicated when it materially affects the answer.
A published answer status must match the actual snapshot publication state.
status_language_rules: Prefer concrete actions over technical labels.
Do not imply certainty beyond the underlying verification state.
Do not promise a completion time unless a verified deadline or service timeframe applies.
Keep historical and current investigations distinguishable.
hard_stops: Never expose internal reasoning through the status view.
Never show a stage as complete when the underlying state is incomplete.
Never imply that evidence retrieval alone establishes the answer.
Never hide a material limitation that changes what the citizen can rely on.
Never expose restricted personal data merely to make the timeline look complete.
